findings.question: q-trigonometry-basic-trigonometric-ratios-0006
findings.quote: This reports sine. The missing opposite leg is twelve. Secant is reciprocal cosine.
findings.problem: The cosine ratio does not fix a side length. For example, a right triangle with adjacent leg 10 and hypotenuse 26 has the stated cosine 5/13, but its opposite leg is 24, not twelve.
findings.fix: Say that a representative triangle with adjacent leg 5 and hypotenuse 13 has opposite leg 12.

findings.question: q-trigonometry-basic-trigonometric-ratios-0009
findings.quote: This repeats sine. The opposite side is five. Use adjacent over hypotenuse for cosine.
findings.problem: The given sine fixes only the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse. A triangle with opposite side 10 and hypotenuse 26 also has sine 5/13, so the opposite side need not be five.
findings.fix: Replace the length claim with "The given ratio is opposite over hypotenuse."
